resume: GATOR turns the FM-1 into a monophonic macro-oscillator after the Mutable Instruments Plaits module: 24 synthesis models, an LPG, an ADSR envelope, two LFOs, an eight-route modulation matrix and 16 presets. On HOME, K1 to K4 are HARMONICS, TIMBRE, MORPH and transposition.

commandes.role: Lowers the keyboard octave (from minus 3 to plus 3).
LPG and output page: K1 DECAY (the decay of the LPG and the internal envelope), K2 COLOUR (from VCA to filter), K3 OUT>AUX (the mix of the two outputs), K4 STEREO (100: OUT left, AUX right).
Called SCL by GATOR: the attenuverters, K1 FM, K2 TIMBRE, K3 MORPH (from minus 100 to plus 100). In TRIG, they scale the internal envelope to pitch, TIMBRE and MORPH.
The modulation envelope, an ADSR started by each note: K1 ATTACK, K2 DECAY, K3 SUSTAIN, K4 RELEASE. On its own it does nothing: it is the ENV source of the matrix (and the volume in GATE).
LFO 1 and 2: K1 and K3 their speed, K2 and K4 their shape (SINE, TRI, SAW, SQUARE, S&H, SMOOTH); SELECT and ALGORITHM: SYNC, the LFO restarts on each note.
The modulation matrix, eight routes: SELECT or ALGORITHM picks the route, K1 the source, K2 the destination, K3 the depth in steps of 5, K4 in steps of 1.
Global settings: K1 GLIDE, K2 BEND RANGE, K3 FINE TUNE, K4 MIDI CH (OMNI or 1 to 16); SELECT LEGATO.
The main page: the model and its settings. Held + a key from 1 to 24: picks the model (the key's LED shows the current model).
Opens the presets page; SELECT picks the slot, SAVE again writes it. Another page button cancels.
Changes the play mode: TRIG, then GATE, then DRONE (lit in GATE and DRONE).
HOLD: notes keep sounding after release (lit); turning it off releases all notes.
On HOME, the model, one at a time (1 to 24). On other pages, whatever they indicate (route, SYNC, LEGATO, slot).
Steps through presets 1 to 16, which load immediately, on all pages except SAVE.
On HOME, the model in steps of eight (the next bank).
The notes, monophonic, last-note priority: releasing a note returns to the previous held one. No velocity (100 out of 127).

gestes: HOME held + a key from 1 to 24: the model.
Knobs accelerate with speed: one step, then two, four, eight; models, LFO shapes, switches and K4 FREQUENCY always advance one step.

modes.texte: The default mode: the volume follows the ADSR of the ENV page, the note sounds as long as the key is held and each knob is heard immediately.
Like the module with a cable in TRIG: a key strikes the LPG, and the sound decays at the DECAY rate (FX) even with the key held. A setting changed after the strike is heard on the next note.
Like the module with no cable: the LPG is bypassed, the sound is continuous, and the keys only change the pitch.

At the top the bank (A, B, C), the model number and its name; the HARM, TIMBRE, MORPH lines show what the parameter does in that model. K4 transposes by plus or minus 24 semitones. At the bottom, an oscilloscope.

a_savoir: An asterisk after the preset number (P3*) flags unsaved changes.
MIDI: notes (velocity to the VEL source), CC 1 wheel, CC 16, 17, 18 HARMONICS, TIMBRE, MORPH, CC 19 the model, pressure, pitch bend; the channel is set on GLO.
